title: DetectResponse
description: Response of POST /detect on detect-py (internal, dev port 8001). UNVERIFIED PLACEHOLDER: authoritative contracts/*.json were not provided; inferred from docs/TECHNOLOGY.md sections 3-4. Reconcile before gateway-rs integration.

ml_score.description: ML probability of scam. null when the model file is missing (gateway-rs must handle null per TECHNOLOGY.md section 4).

scam_type_hint.description: Best rule-category guess (e.g. loan, otp, vishing); null if none matched.

type.description: Stable signal id: ml_missing | url_shortener | typosquat | punycode | ip_host | rdap_fail | domain_young | urgency_language | payment_demand | remote_access_request | secrecy_demand | vishing_pattern | rule:<rule_id>

detail.description: Short evidence string. Must not echo raw message content beyond the matched token.
